release_notes:
Newsletter batch scheduler + API-services pricing fixes + SMS throttle

- Newsletter batch scheduler with batching, delay (sec/min/hr), start time + timezone, progress/completion dashboard, dedicated template, test send, guest subscribers, per-recipient unsubscribe, and a Newsletters menu group.
- API Services: Set-Price-Margins popup updates Price on save; below-cost prices bold red.
- SMS: short pause between consecutive gateway sends.
